questions.question: Lalgudi Gopala Iyer Jayaraman used to play which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Lalgudi G. Jayaraman was a legendary Violin virtuoso of the Carnatic music tradition. He is part of the 'Violin Trinity' of Carnatic music and is celebrated for inventing the Lalgudi Bani, a unique style that closely mimics the nuances of the human voice.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities along with his sons played ‘Raga for Peace’ in the year 2014 at the ‘Nobel Peace Prize Concert’?
questions.solution: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, along with his sons Amaan Ali Bangash and Ayaan Ali Bangash, performed 'Raga for Peace' at the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize Concert. The performance was a tribute to the laureates Kailash Satyarthi and Malala Yousafzai.

questions.question: Who among the following Hindustani classical instrumentalists won the Grammy Award in 1993 for his album ‘A Meeting by The River’ with Ry Cooder?
questions.solution: Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt won the Grammy Award in 1993 for his collaborative album 'A Meeting by The River' with American guitarist Ry Cooder. He is the creator of the Mohan Veena, a highly modified slide guitar used in Hindustani classical music.

questions.question: Hafiz Ali Khan was an Indian __________ player of the Bangash gharana.
questions.solution: Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan was a legendary Sarod maestro of the Bangash Gharana. He was the father and guru of Ustad Amjad Ali Khan and served as a court musician in the princely state of Gwalior.

questions.question: Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri is associated with ___________ instrument.
questions.solution: Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri is a world-renowned Tabla maestro of the Lucknow Gharana. He is highly respected for his technical clarity and is a prominent teacher at the Ali Akbar College of Music.
